facts.text: Browser cookie policy changes affect federated authentication and cross-domain hosting scenarios.
Changes impact Outlook add-in, SharePoint app hosting, Microsoft Entra authentication, and iframe embedding.
Google Chrome 80 and Microsoft Edge implement SameSite cookie attribute changes starting early 2020.
Cookies default to SameSite=Lax and insecure SameSite=None cookies are rejected.
Minimum recommended updates include Dynamics NAV 2015 CU 61, 2016 CU 49, 2017 CU 36, 2018 CU 23, and Business Central updates.
In web farm deployments add SameSite attribute to session affinity cookie with rewrite rules.
Test using Chrome 80 Beta or by enabling SameSite flags in older Chrome versions at chrome://flags.
